title: ENDURE
tagline: His love endures — so can your hope.
focus_line: Hope is the confident expectation in God's promises, anchored in Christ.

verse.text: Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise; give thanks to him and praise his name. For the Lord is good and his love endures forever; his faithfulness continues through all generations.

session.prompt: Enter His presence with thanksgiving — sing or speak praise for who He is.
How has God's faithfulness been present in your life?

coaching_notes: Looking for a song for your worship block today? Check out “Yes and Amen” (feat. Chris McClarney) by Jesus Culture. All God's promises are yes and amen.
